faq.headingAccent: before you build a mobile app.
faq.subtitle: What gets built for iOS and Android, how stores work, and what the business receives.
faq.a1: aiAPP is aiNOW's mobile app builder for iOS and Android. It covers product definition, design, development, testing, store release, and handover.
faq.q2: When does a business need a mobile app instead of a website?
faq.a2: A mobile app is useful when customers return often, need push notifications, location, camera, loyalty, booking, delivery tracking, or a faster signed-in experience.
faq.q3: Does the business need a developer?
faq.a3: No. aiNOW designs and builds the app, admin tools, and integrations. You approve the audience, features, screens, business rules, and release.
faq.q4: Will the app work on both iPhone and Android?
faq.a4: Yes, when the agreed scope supports both platforms. aiNOW tests the main journeys on current phone sizes and prepares both store releases.
faq.q5: What result does the business get?
faq.a5: The business receives the mobile app, source code, design assets, store access, admin access, analytics setup, and operating documentation defined in the project.
faq.q6: What if the task is still unclear?
faq.a6: The audit maps the task, the exceptions, the people involved, and the useful result before a build is proposed.
faq.q7: Is the audit fee credited to the build?
faq.a7: Yes. The full audit fee is deducted from the agreed build price.
faq.a8: aiNOW shows the effect on price and timing before the added work starts.
faq.q9: Can an internal team build the first version?
faq.a9: Yes. aiAPP is useful when the application must also be checked, launched, documented, and handed over for daily use.
faq.q10: Can aiAPP build a normal business application?
faq.a10: Yes, when the application includes automated decisions, customer replies, document work, or connections to existing systems.
faq.a11: No public case studies are claimed here. The paid audit is the small first step for checking the approach on your process.
faq.q12: Does aiNOW hold SOC 2 or ISO certification?
faq.a12: Not currently. If procurement requires a specific certificate, that boundary is confirmed before work begins.
faq.q13: Can it connect to existing systems?
faq.a13: Often yes. The audit confirms available access and shows any limitation before the integration is included in scope.
faq.a14: aiAPP builds a new application. vibecoding.ge checks and repairs an application that already exists.

eval.heading: What work will the application do?
eval.subtitle: A customer asks for an order update. aiAPP finds the order, checks its owner, and only then prepares the answer.

trace.heading: How is an expense checked before it reaches the books?
trace.subtitle: An employee uploads a supplier invoice. aiAPP checks the details, requests approval, and only then sends it to accounting.
trace.safetyCheckDetail: The supplier, amount, and document number match.
trace.actionDetail: The expense is within the agreed limit and approval is recorded.
trace.customerResultDetail: The approved invoice is ready for payment.

ladder.heading: Start small, then choose the next step.
ladder.subtitle: A small audit comes first. The business then chooses whether to build, add support, or stop there.
ladder.stageLabel: From idea to a working application
ladder.r1what: aiNOW maps the task and gives a clear scope, date, and cost estimate.
ladder.r1highlight: If the build is not worthwhile, the business receives the reason and a better next step.
ladder.r2what: aiNOW builds the agreed application, checks real work situations, and prepares the handover.
ladder.r2highlight: The full USD 1,500 audit fee is deducted from the build price.
ladder.r3what: aiNOW monitors costs, maintains connections, and helps the team after launch.
ladder.r3highlight: Support is optional and can stop whenever the business chooses.
ladder.businessResult: The business tests the idea with one small fixed step before deciding to build.
